Retrieve a specific shipment with an unique reference like shipmentId or trackingNumber.

variable.description:
(Required) By default this is the shipment __tracking number__ e.g. `N4242`. 

In case a tracking number is not available, the shipment id can be used.

Supported references:
* __tracking number__
  * `{trackingNumber}` or `tracking-number:{trackingNumber}`
  * e.g. `N4242` or `tracking-number:N4242`
* __shipment id__
  * `shipment-id:{shipmentId}` 
  * e.g. `shipment-id:19101910`

response.name: OK
